description:
When a Beadwork goal ends, drop `run` mode and forget the session's open minions group.

## Background

If `run` sticks after the epic is closed, the standing appendix keeps telling the parent to orchestrate. If the group is not forgotten, the next `/bw run` joins a stale group (old cwd, old path intent).

## Locked UX

- Command to abandon: **`/bw abandon`** (no extra spelling debate). Halts live orchestrated children, forgets the group, exits `run`.
- `beadwork_close_issue` of the **scoped epic** exits `run` and injects a short parent prompt: epic closed, halt remaining minions, stop orchestrating. Do not import minions internals. Do not invent an event handshake or completionToken.
- Halt of the minion group **alone** does not exit goal mode.
- Closing a **ticket** (not the scoped epic) does not exit goal mode.
- Shell `bw close` of the epic is not watched; noticed on the next parent refresh (same class as shell `bw close` on tickets).

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/index.ts` close_issue path (worker tools already gone)
- session-state
- commands / completions for `/bw abandon`
- tests

## Success criteria

- Close scoped epic → mode not run; ticket close → mode still run.
- `/bw abandon` → mode not run.
- Halt group → mode still run.
- After exit, next `orchestrate` creates a new groupId.

## Test plan

- Unit: close epic vs close ticket vs abandon vs halt.
- Unit: abandon completions exist; print/json reject abandon if they reject run.
- Integration (once minions halt exists): abandon results in no live orchestrated children and no open group.
- Log: command, epic id, previous mode, new mode, whether halt was requested.

## Considerations

index.ts hotspot: blocked by worker-tool deletion. Beadwork must not import AgentTree. If halt cannot be invoked in-process, the injected parent prompt “halt remaining minions” is the fallback and must be tested as sendMessage content.
title: Exit goal mode on epic close or abandon and forget the minion group
